title: Driving enjoyment and feature disappointments
summary: Reviews center on enjoying the G60’s driving feel and certain features, with isolated disappointment about the trunk and a missing or changed feature compared with a prior BMW.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the way the vehicle drives, enjoyment on early drives, music with relax mode, and the ability to code additional settings.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on disappointment with the trunk.

mixed.summary: Mixed feedback describes disappointment over a feature the reviewer had enjoyed on a previous BMW, indicating both appreciation and dissatisfaction.

limitations: This topic combines several distinct subjects, including driving enjoyment, infotainment or relax mode, coding settings, trunk space or design, and comparison to a prior BMW.
The sample is small, so examples are insufficient to determine how broadly each specific aspect applies within the topic.
